title: Missing Number
summary: An array of length n contains distinct numbers drawn from 0 through n.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10000 values. Each value is in [0,n] and occurs at most once. XOR may use 32-bit words.

statement: An array of length n contains distinct numbers drawn from 0 through n. Return the missing number.

examples.explanation: The only unused value in [0,2] is 1.
The missing value can be n.

constraints: 1–10000 values. Each value is in [0,n] and occurs at most once. XOR may use 32-bit words.
hints: Conceptual: There is one more possible value than input elements.
Directional: Cancel the present values against a complete enumeration.
Implementation: Start with n and XOR each index with the value at that index.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
